ITA-5.66.77 bahalavartma बहलवर्त्म
Multiple Meibomian cysts
A disorder characterized by the whole eyelid being full of boils; having same colour as eyelids; even boils; large muscular growth; firm colourless boils in eyelids.

ITA-9.2.9 bahiḥparimārjanam बहिःपरिमार्जनम्
External cleansing therapies
Therapeutic procedures involving the external application of medicines.

ITA-1.9.3.7.11 jaṅgamaḥ/ bahirantaścetanaḥ जङ्गमः/ बहिरन्तश्चेतनः
Mobile life form with internal and external sentience
Any living being in the animal kingdom which visibly reacts to external stimuli.

ITA-5.6.36 bahirvegajvaraḥ बहिर्वेगज्वरः
Fever in which dosha and A disorder characterized by high-grade external temperature; symptoms are located in decreased severity of thirst. supportive tissues

ITA-9.2.62 bahupānam बहुपानम्
Sweating induced by drinking large amounts of alcohol
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis is achieved by excessive intake of alcoholic beverages.

ITA-5.13.1 bāhyajakṛmiḥ बाह्यजकृमिः
External worm infestation
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: itching; wheal-like skin eruptions; papules/ eruptions; nodular swelling.

ITA-9.2.11 bāhyasnehaḥ बाह्यस्नेहः
External oleation
External oleation of the body.

bāhyahetuḥ बाह्यहेतुः
Extrinsic cause
External causes that include vitiation of dosha through alterations in food, behavioural patterns and time.
